title: Clairic×Clefで書類の自動分類と項目抽出
excerpt: Cloudflareの抽出特化モデルClairicと判断特化モデルClefを組み合わせ、書類種別判定と項目抽出の速度・精度・運用上の注意点を整理します。日本語画像OCRが課題で、テキスト入力での精度改善例も紹介します。
persona: 請求書や領収書の処理を効率化したい個人事業主のBさん

image_prompts.featured: An illustration of various business documents being scanned into a cloud service, with speed lines to suggest fast automated processing.
image_prompts.scenario: An illustration of a person at a desk sorting invoices and checking results on a laptop, with paper documents and a calm office setting.
